What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary_extracted: April 29, 2026: FOMC held rates at 3.5%-3.75% in an 8-4 split vote (last 4-dissenter vote was Oct 1992). Elevated inflation cited partly due to global energy prices and tariffs. Markets pricing in no rate changes for rest of 2026 and into 2027. Powell's final meeting as Fed Chair.
